topic.title: Four-day upper circuit streak drives this small-cap stock up 74%; here’s the key trigger behind the jump
topic.source_snippet: Cubex Tubings has seen its shares hit an upper circuit limit, reflecting investor confidence, with a 74% gain over four days. The small-cap stock's market cap is  ₹210 crore, rising to an all-time high of  ₹152.24 after significant recent losses.

news_analysis.headline_hook: 4 days-la 74% growth-ah? Unga 1 lakh investment-la evlo loss aagumnu theriyuma?
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Cubex Tubings surged 74% across four consecutive upper circuit sessions, pushing its stock price to an all-time high of ₹152.24 and its market capitalization to ₹210 crore following a period of sharp losses.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume the four-day 74% rally signals an unmissable fundamental turnaround, driving them to place market buy orders directly at upper circuit limits.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: In micro-caps with a market cap of just ₹210 crore, consecutive upper circuits create extreme illiquidity where retail buyers cannot get filled during the rise, but will bear 100% of the downside risk when early holders exit and trigger locked lower circuits.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never submit aftermarket buy orders (AMOs) or market orders for micro-cap stocks locked in upper circuits after a 50%+ multi-day rally.

comparison_data.myth: Retail belief: 4 days upper circuit-na stock fundamental-ah strong-nu nambi market buy order poduvathu.
comparison_data.reality: Institutional truth: ₹210 crore market cap stocks-la liquidity irukkathu, so exit aagum pothu lower circuit-la lock aagiduvom.

stat_data.label: compounding loss / risk in Tanglish
stat_data.context: 4 naalla 74% erincha stock, adutha 2 naalla 40% vizhuntha, unga capital-la 30% loss confirm. Illiquid stocks-la entry kidaikkum, aana exit kidaikkathu!

slides.title: How the Liquidity Trap Works
slides.card_text: 1. Upper circuit-la buy order poduvom, aana seller-e irukka maataanga. 2. Price peak-ku ponathum, early holders dump pannuvanga. 3. Suddenly lower circuit hit aagum, ippo unga order-um execute aagathu, loss-um control panna mudiyathu.

slides.title: Institutional Exit Strategy
slides.card_text: Smart money eppovum hype peak-la irukkum pothu exit aaguvanga. Retailers 'FOMO'-la entry edukum pothu, institutions avanga shares-ah sell panni profit book pannuvanga. Micro-cap-la volume illatha pothu, retail-ku exit door lock aagidum.

slides.title: The Golden Execution Rule
slides.card_text: Never submit aftermarket buy orders (AMOs) or market orders for micro-cap stocks that have already rallied 50%+ in a few days. If you can't exit easily, don't enter at all!
